title: 印度母婴护理的可审计急诊分诊系统
summary: Noora Health 将 LLM 分诊拆分为两步：LLM 按临床词表提取症状与患者背景，确定性规则引擎判断急诊场景。召回率从 0.565 提升至 0.810，F1 从 0.606 提升至 0.702，并实现可审计性与快速规则迭代。
summary_en: Noora Health decomposed LLM triage into two steps: an LLM extracts canonical symptoms and patient context using a clinician-authored vocabulary, and a deterministic rule engine identifies emergencies. Recall rose from 0.565 to 0.810 and F1 from 0.606 to 0.702, enabling auditability and rapid rule iteration.
